exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, non-scheduled cesarean section, scheduled cesarean section)
cohort: 501 HIV-1 infected women in Nairobi, Kenya who received short-course zidovudine
finding: Non-scheduled cesarean section was an independent risk factor for postpartum mortality in HIV-1 positive Kenyan women.
mod_finding: Women who underwent non-scheduled cesarean section had a 3.39-fold higher risk of mortality in the first year postpartum compared to women with vaginal delivery.
